#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool get(int w, int m) {
    if (m == 0) return true;
    if (m % w != 0) return false;
    m /= w;
    if (m == 1) return true;
    return get(w, m) || get(w, m - 1) || get(w, m + 1);
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    bool ans = get(w, m) || get(w, m - 1) || get(w, m + 1);
    cout << (ans ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
